enchantment.apothic_enchanting.berserker: When hurt, may enrage you: Strength, Resistance and Speed for 25 s at a health cost. 45 s cooldown. Curse.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.boon_of_t: Mining stone, deepslate or Nether stone can drop bonus ores. Higher levels raise the chance.
Axe fells the whole connected tree at once.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.chromatic: Sheared wool comes out in a random color.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.crescendo: Fire extra crossbow shots before reloading; +1 shot per level.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.endless_q: Bow uses no arrows at all, any kind. Not with Infinity.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.growth_se: Sheared sheep have a 50% chance to regrow wool instantly.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.icy_thorn: Attackers may get a long Slowness; chance and strength scale with level. Not with Thorns.
Internal marker for Apothic infusion crafting. No effect on gear.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.knowledge: Item drops from your kills become XP instead (the items are lost).
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.life_mend: Healing you receive repairs enchanted gear instead, reducing your healing. Better repair per level. Curse; not with Mending.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.miners_fe: Large mining-speed boost, but blocks can never break instantly. Not with Efficiency.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.natures_b: Right-click crops to bonemeal them using hoe durability; less durability per level.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.reboundin: Melee attackers are knocked away and upward; stronger per level.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.reflectiv: Shield blocks can reflect part of the damage to the attacker; chance and share rise per level.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.scavenger: Kills have +2.5% per level to roll the mob's loot an extra time.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.shield_ba: Attacking with the shield deals bonus damage, costing shield durability.
Farm animals follow you while you hold this hoe.
enchantment.apothic_enchanting.worker_ex: Shearing gives double wool but hurts the sheep.
